# George Kanaroglou

> Full-stack marketing in London and Athens: pricing strategy, brand strategy and digital marketing, built on marketing analytics and consumer psychology.

George Kanaroglou is a marketing professional working between London and Athens. He is Insights Lead for racing driver Sophia Flörsch at Barracudaworks, a sports branding and commercial strategy agency. He holds an MSc in Marketing from the London School of Economics and a First Class BSc in International Business from the University of Kent. He works in English and Greek.

## What he does

- Pricing strategy: setting prices people will pay and that grow the business, using research into what customers value and would pay, and building tiers and packages around it.
- Brand strategy: deciding what a brand stands for and making it the easy choice, through positioning, messaging and how it compares with competitors.
- Digital marketing: turning attention online into results, through channel strategy, content and paid campaigns measured against real goals.

## What it is built on

- Marketing analytics: surveys, experiments and dashboards that show what is working and what to change.
- Consumer psychology: choice architecture, habits and social proof, used to make the right choice the easy one.
